problem: The exponent is missing its superscript, so the ranges read literally as '0 to 2n−1' and '−2n−1 to 2n−1−1', which is not the standard range and gives a wrong formula if read as printed. Elsewhere the chapter does use <sup>, so the notation is inconsistent.
fix: Write 0 to 2<sup>n</sup>−1; −2<sup>n−1</sup> to 2<sup>n−1</sup>−1; and 'modulo 2<sup>n</sup>' (for 8 bits: 0 to 255 and −128 to 127).

problem: The 'live' mark on the '7 in BCD' row is at cell index 4, which holds 0 in 0000 0111. The intended highlighted bit (the first 1 of the low nibble) is at index 5.
fix: Move that mark to index 5, or drop it, so the highlighted cell of 7 lines up with the leading 1 of its 0111 nibble.
